title: GOP joint-fundraising network analysis — depth 1
summary: Three official FEC committee pages establish participant links from RNC, NRCC, and NRSC to active joint fundraising committees; exact transfer recipients remain a depth-2 transaction task.

sources.title: TRUMP NATIONAL COMMITTEE JFC, INC. committee overview

provenance.method: official FEC participant and financial-summary extraction

data.question: Which high-signal joint fundraising committees formally connect the national GOP committees to candidate, state-party, and PAC networks?
data.method: Official FEC committee-page review, participant extraction, financial-summary capture, and bounded relation normalization.
data.framework: Formal-participant graph separated from transaction-level transfer attribution and control claims.
data.scope: Trump National Committee JFC, Invest in America 2026, Team Moreno, and current RNC, NRCC, and NRSC treasurers.
findings: The FEC currently lists the RNC as a participant in Trump National Committee JFC, the NRCC in Invest in America 2026, and the NRSC in Team Moreno.
Trump National Committee JFC reports $98.60 million in receipts through June 30, 2026.
Team Moreno reports $6.52 million in receipts and $4.95 million in transfers to affiliated committees through June 30, 2026; the summary page alone does not identify exact recipients.
The FEC lists Jennifer Rich, Katy Williams, and Kristi Broghamer as treasurers of RNC, NRCC, and NRSC respectively.
conclusions: The participant and officer edges are directly documented and safe to normalize.
Reported JFC totals cannot be assigned to any specific participant without itemized Schedule B and recipient Schedule A records.
Team Moreno is the strongest next recursive node because of its broad current participant list and reported affiliated transfers.
recommendations: Resolve exact transfer edges using Form 3X Line 22 and Schedule B plus recipient Line 12 and Schedule A.
Expand Team Moreno participant committees by FEC ID after transfer reconciliation.
Do not infer coordination, control, or beneficiary amounts from participant status alone.
counterarguments: Committee pages and summary totals may change after amended filings.
A listed participant may receive no funds during a particular reporting period.
